editorial:
Imagine you are driving through a lonely area and get stuck in a tiny town with a weird local radio station. That is exactly where you land in this story. You follow a woman who ends up teaming up with some radio folks after they start picking up a strange signal. It turns out to be the ghost of a girl who was murdered, and she is trying to tell them who killed her. The vibe is very spooky and moody, making you feel like something is always watching from the shadows while the characters scramble to piece together the clues.

The acting is solid and the mystery actually keeps you guessing for a good while. While the pace slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff at the end makes it worth the wait. If you love ghosts and cold cases, you should definitely give this one a shot. Since the dark scenes are a big part of the mood, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to ensure you see every detail in the dark.
endingExplained: You find out that the local sheriff is actually the killer. He tried to cover up his crime, but the ghost's signal led the group right to the truth. In the final scenes, there is a tense showdown where the truth comes out. The ghost finally gets her revenge and finds peace once her murderer is caught. It wraps up with a feeling of justice being served after a long time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories and small-town mysteries.
